description: Undersized xmalloc (4 + addrs*40 - 1 instead of + 1) for DNS server list buffer, allowing heap overflow when writing formatted DHCPv6 DNS server addresses

Custom pool allocator (nvalloc/nvfree) for temporary awk variables allows a freed variable's pool slot to be reused while a stale reference is still held, causing a use-after-free when processing a crafted awk pattern
Signed int overflow of runCnt/dbufCount (attacker-controlled via crafted bzip2 input) bypasses the dbufCount+runCnt>dbufSize bounds check, causing an out-of-bounds write into dbuf
Missing check for argv[1] before dereferencing it when a section name is supplied without a following page argument (e.g. man 1), causing a NULL pointer dereference
pos is checked for negative once but a subsequent adjustment can push it negative again without re-validation, allowing a read before the start of the output buffer when decoding crafted LZMA input
